expectations.text: The agent does not tag the off-by-one bug comment as a nit
expectations.evidence: The agent classified the `range(len(s) - 1)` off-by-one comment as a substantive `fix` (a real functional defect — the loop skips the last element) with no nit indicator.

expectations.text: The agent does not trigger the nits-only gate because at least one actionable comment is not a nit
expectations.evidence: Because the off-by-one row is a non-nit actionable comment, the Step 6d trigger (every actionable row is a nit) was not met; the agent proceeded to Step 7 without entering the nits-only gate.

expectations.text: The agent applies and commits both changes in auto mode without halting for a per-nit decision table
expectations.evidence: In auto mode the agent edited src/parser.py to `range(len(s))` and renamed `s` to `source`, then committed both with Co-authored-by trailers — no decision table was presented.
